description: This is a PHP unit test class for the ReportingMethodConfigurationService. It tests various functionalities such as retrieving, deleting, saving, and counting reporting methods using mocks of the data access object. The file is part of the test suite for the HRM system and specifically tests the service layer for reporting method configurations.

classes.name: ReportingMethodConfigurationServiceTest
classes.description: Unit test class for ReportingMethodConfigurationService, includes setup and several test methods for CRUD operations and counting reporting methods.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test case, sets up the service and loads test fixture data.

methods.name: testGetReportingMethodList
methods.description: Tests retrieval of reporting method list with mocked DAO.

methods.name: testGetReportingMethodById
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a reporting method by ID with mocked DAO.

methods.name: testDeleteReportingMethods
methods.description: Tests deletion of reporting methods with mocked DAO.

methods.name: testGetReportingMethodByName
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a reporting method by name with mocked DAO.

methods.name: testSaveReportingMethod
methods.description: Tests saving a reporting method with mocked DAO.

methods.name: testGetReportingMethodCount
methods.description: Tests counting reporting methods with mocked DAO.
